runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
The memo applies **180 days after it was issued**. It was dated April 3, 2025 (EXECUTIVE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND BUDGET WASHINGTON, D.C. 20503 THE DIRECTOR April 3, 2025 M-25-22), so by my count the 180-day mark falls on September 30, 2025. The document itself gives only the 180-day interval, not that calendar date.

The trigger is the solicitation date, not the award date. Under the memo's future-contracts provision, it covers contracts awarded from solicitations issued on or after that point, and it also reaches option renewals or extensions exercised after that point on existing contracts (shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum).

It does not cover every AI acquisition: This memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
